items.title: Worthia "Showboy" Thomas Interview, 1961-12-11
items.q: Gilly shows wasn't much to them. Yeah. It wasn't much to them.

ctx.x: Gilly. Gilly shows wasn't much to them. Yeah. It wasn't much to them. There's plenty of time if you, if we run into a fella that we know and haven't seen for a good while, you say, Man, I'm with build-age-hands show. We laugh at it. We say, Man, you want to build-age-show. But build-age-hands didn't have show-cars. Didn't have dining-cars or nothing like that. You just jump up in the truck and going where .
How was the pay? I'm not trying to butt into your personal affairs and all, but I just wondered, did they furnish lodging? Did you sleep on the train if they had a car there and furnish meals?
